text.note: kept RGB: 85 Type 3 fonts block Ghostscript's CMYK conversion (guide p.6 accepts RGB, their preflight converts); transparency left on 71 pages (the flattening pass could not clear it)

checks.name: Text file page size is 222 x 285 mm
checks.detail: 222.00 x 285.00 mm = 216 x 279 mm trim plus 3 mm bleed (their text template is 222 x 285)

checks.name: Bleed is 3 mm on all four edges
checks.detail: guide p.5 requires 3 mm; media extends 3 mm past the trim on every side

checks.name: Bleed continues the page edge
checks.detail: 112 of 112 points across the cut lines are flat

checks.name: Page artwork survives assembly
checks.detail: sampled interior pages carry the master's artwork

checks.name: Bleed seam matches the artwork
checks.detail: the smear meets the page with no visible step in the bleed

checks.name: Single pages, portrait
checks.detail: 191 single pages, portrait, all 222.0 mm wide

checks.name: Page count is 12n-1
checks.detail: 191 pages (180 of book, 11 blank added at the rear); guide p.5: supply one less than a divisible of 12, the production barcode is added to the last page

checks.name: Last page is clear for their barcode
checks.detail: the final page is blank, so the barcode they add lands on nothing

checks.name: Cover pages stripped from the interior
checks.detail: the front cover and the back cover are removed: they belong in the cover file, and leaving them in prints the cover twice

checks.name: No Type 3 glyph-program fonts
checks.detail: 85 Type 3 fonts. These carry headings as drawing programs instead of an embedded font, so preflight rates them lowest of all font types, and Ghostscript 10.02.1 segfaults converting them to CMYK -- this book therefore stays RGB, which BookVault accept and convert themselves

checks.name: Transparency flattened
checks.detail: 71 pages still carry it (page 1: image soft mask); Ghostscript's flattening pass ran and left it in place, so it has to be cleared before a print run (guide p.3)

checks.name: Images at 300 DPI or better
checks.detail: 150 below 300 DPI, e.g. page 2: 150 DPI; page 4: 150 DPI; page 5: 150 DPI

checks.name: Binding-edge clearance
checks.detail: closest text is 18.1 mm from the left edge on page 63; guide p.3 asks for 20 mm on the gutter, their template prints 17 mm

checks.name: No trim or bleed marks
checks.detail: none are drawn, and the media box is exactly trim + bleed (222.00 x 285.00 mm), leaving no room for any

checks.name: Text file is PDF/X-1a:2001 with CMYK
checks.detail: kept RGB: 85 Type 3 fonts block Ghostscript's CMYK conversion (guide p.6 accepts RGB, their preflight converts); transparency left on 71 pages (the flattening pass could not clear it)

checks.name: Cover file is a perfect-bound spread
checks.detail: 448.99 x 284.99 mm = back 216 + spine 11 + front 216 + 3 mm bleed, by their p.18 formula

checks.name: Barcode area clear on the back cover
checks.detail: the 38 x 25 mm box their template reserves (6.4 mm in from the right trim, 3.3 mm up) is 58.2% covered by artwork; a barcode is required printing outside the UK

checks.name: Spine width taken from their sizing calculator
checks.detail: built at 11 mm from 191 pages x 0.056 mm per page, rounded up (guide p.18). Run home > help > sizing calculator for the real paper and rebuild with --spine-mm <mm>
